page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines from top to bottom; a woodcut vignette with a motto in the middle; imprint at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.l: GENSEM, CVM EX CLEMENTISSIMO REGIÆ MA-
jestatis mandato, Arcis templum ab omni idololatricâ fœditate
E Germanico in Latinum idioma conversus
M. CHRISTIANO KYFERTO, Sil. Eccles. Palat.
[woodcut vignette with the motto "FATA VIAM INVENIENT"]
Prostat in Bibliopolio vidua IONÆ ROSÆ. M. DC. XX.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a figure with a dragon or serpent within a cartouche bearing the motto "FATA VIAM INVENIENT"; it is described, not transcribed as text. The handwritten "2" at the top right is a later annotation and is not transcribed. Line "jestatis" is printed with a long-s-like form and is kept as printed; the "12/22" date is a fraction printed as superscript/subscript numerals.
